summary: Nginx on node1 now serves HTTP 200 at / on TCP port 6700 and recovered successfully after a full node restart.
actions_performed: Configured a dedicated server block on IPv4 and IPv6 port 6700.
Allowed TCP 6700 through SELinux and firewalld persistently.
Verified the endpoint directly through node1's managed IP.
Restarted node1 and verified persistent recovery.

evidence.requirement: Nginx serves a successful HTTP response at / on TCP port 6700
evidence.summary: Before and after restart, Nginx was active and listening on port 6700; direct requests to $NODE_IP:6700/ returned HTTP/1.1 200 OK with the expected body.

evidence.requirement: SELinux and firewall permit TCP port 6700 persistently
evidence.summary: Port 6700 is labeled http_port_t, and both runtime and permanent firewalld checks returned yes before and after restart.

Healthy baseline boot ID 03408ac4-bfe4-4151-98bd-1966b0a205af was captured, reboot was acknowledged, the new boot ID dca5eab5-29cf-405f-aa39-60d9bae729a5 proved a node restart, and post-restart checks confirmed Nginx active/enabled, valid configuration, listeners on port 6700, persistent policy, and HTTP 200 recovery.
